segments.text: Andrew Thomas Norway lives in St. Paul, but he's one of those doctors and nurses who flew to New York to help with flood of COVID patients who filled New York hospitals. segments.speaker: Andrew Thomas
segments.text: Normally, there'd be family all over the place. But the families are not able to come close to the hospital. segments.speaker: Ira Glass
segments.text: Most of them are unconscious, in medically-induced comas, because it's easier to survive on a ventilator that way. segments.speaker: Andrew Thomas
segments.text: Yeah, so people end up focusing on what you can see, which is embellishments like earrings and hairstyles and fingernail polish, and also just trying to emphasize that the people are comfortable, that they're sleeping. segments.text: And what's your hope about how the families will take this?
